units.source_text: 古歌：“天明花发艳，转瞬即凋零。

en.t: An old poem says: “At daybreak the flowers bloom in splendor, only to wither in an instant.

units.source_text: 但看朝颜色，无常世相明。”

en.t: Look only at their morning colors, and the impermanence of the world becomes clear.”
This appears in Flowers and Birds: Lingering Sentiments.
